rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for asserting that something is true or strongly emphasizing an adjective or verb.

example.english: I really forgot what you said.
example.traditional: 我真係唔記得咗你講乜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 nei5 gong2 mat1

rows.note: Use this specifically to introduce an actual fact or correction, rather than to add emotional emphasis.

example.english: Actually, I really don't know him.
example.jyutping: kei4 sat6 ngo5 m4 sik1 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for the degree sense before an adjective or verb, especially in combinations such as 好開心 or 好想去.

example.english: I really want to eat fish balls.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 sik6 jyu4 daan2
